description: Scott is a nationally renowned leader on housing, authoring California's most consequential streamlining laws resulting in the construction of tens of thousands of homes — including 3,000+ below market rate, affordable homes in San Francisco. He helped build the statewide YIMBY movement and turned a political third rail into policy reality by taking on the status quo and Sacramento insiders.
paid_for_by: paid for by reversing big portions of the Bush and Trump mega tax cuts on corporations and the wealthy
title: Housing
